name: Sky High Sanctuary
description: An architectural masterpiece nestled 40 feet above the forest floor, offering panoramic views of the Pacific Northwest. This luxury treehouse features floor-to-ceiling windows, a private hot tub, and a spiral staircase leading to a rooftop deck.

name: Whispering Pines Retreat
description: A family-friendly treehouse complex with multiple connected platforms, rope bridges, and a tree-top zip line. Perfect for adventurous families seeking an unforgettable forest experience.

name: Eco-Treehouse Haven
description: A completely sustainable, off-grid treehouse powered by solar panels with composting toilets and rainwater collection. Experience true eco-living while surrounded by ancient redwoods.
